The phone checks started after a September news report said OpenAI’s newest model, Astra, uses a new method that makes it smarter but writes down less of its thinking, so humans can see less of how it reaches answers. 
so the concern was, if future models think without writing those steps down, as the researchers feared Astra-style designs might, investigators would see only what the agents did, not why.
